receipts.subject: Re: OpenMath: your Ramsey results for expert review
receipts.body:
Hi Rachel, Wenyi and Hamdi, your Ramsey results look promising; please send one final team repository and submission references before the cutoff.
For each result you want judged, include its exact claim, proof/checker, reproduction steps, paper and a short note on what is new.
Please confirm the team roster and flag anything incomplete or blocked so I can help.
receipts.note: Reply includes the original thread quotation; new three-line body matches.

receipts.subject: Re: OpenMath: polished 21/48 synthesis claim and proof packet
receipts.body:
Hi Matt, I’m keen to review the synthesis result; please send the final repository, manuscript and formal proof materials before the cutoff.
Please make the exact theorem hypotheses, claimed gate bounds and any remaining proof gaps explicit, with reproduction instructions.
What remains to finish, and is there anything specific you need help with?
receipts.note: Reply includes the original thread quotation; new three-line body matches.

receipts.subject: Re: OpenMath: Collatz descent packet and final submission details
receipts.body:
Thanks, Chaewon, I’ve received the repository and the expanded report, certificate and reproduction materials; I’ll review them shortly.
The evaluator report still says final=false: please send the final submission reference/receipt, or describe the exact step that is blocking you.
Please also confirm the final commit and whether the Busy Beaver work is a separate submission.
receipts.note: Reply includes the original thread quotation; new three-line body matches.

receipts.subject: Re: OpenMath: your Leanification paper and completed theorem packet
receipts.body:
Thanks, Luca, I have the repository and will begin reviewing; thank you also for clarifying that Leanification has five contributors.
Please send their names/contributions and clarify how they map to the two teams Ueverton registered; I’ll check the roster issue with the organizers.
Please confirm the final commit and official submission reference, and make the repository credits reflect everyone’s actual contribution.
receipts.note: Reply includes the original thread quotation; new three-line body matches.

receipts.subject: Re: OpenMath: Bosonic Arrow and Ramtastic review packets
receipts.body:
Hi Chris, I can access Ramtastic, but the Bosonic Arrow repository returns 404; please share access and the final submission references before the cutoff.
For each project, please identify the finished theorem or certificate, include the paper and reproduction instructions, and mark unfinished work clearly.
Is anything blocking completion or access? Let me know so I can help.
receipts.note: Reply includes the original thread quotation; new three-line body matches.

receipts.subject: Re: OpenMath: star-colouring proof scope and final materials
receipts.body:
Hi Woohyuk, your Ramsey and 39-line Kobon validation results look promising; please send the final repository and submission references before the cutoff.
Please include exact witnesses/checkers and the star-colouring proof, with the precise hypotheses, paper and novelty note for each claim.
I know your admission/workflow questions remain unresolved; which exact organizer decision or submission step is blocking you now?
receipts.note: Reply includes the original thread quotation; new three-line body matches.

receipts.subject: OpenMath: final campaign packets and submission blocker
receipts.body:
Hi Jamie, I found your seven-hill campaign; the status page still reports zero official submissions and an organizer-route blocker.
Please send the strongest finished claim packets, pinned commits, proofs/certificates, papers and novelty notes, clearly marking conditional or unfinished results.
Which exact submission step is blocking you? Please describe it so we can resolve the route before the cutoff.

receipts.subject: OpenMath: Adaptive Turing Machines final materials
receipts.body:
Hi Willem, are you submitting a completed result from Adaptive Turing Machines? Please send the final repository and submission reference before the cutoff.
Include the exact machine/witness, halting certificate and checker, paper and reproduction instructions; mark exploratory or unfinished work clearly.
Let me know if access, checking or submission is blocking you so I can help.

Hi Ilknur, I found Tissue Busy Beaver; are you submitting a formal mathematical result from it to OpenMath?
If so, please share the repository, exact model/theorem, proof or certificate, paper, reproduction steps and submission reference before the cutoff.
Please distinguish the toy-model result from biological validation, and let me know what is still unfinished or blocked.

Hi Shafeeq, I found both Ramsay Multiplier project pages; please confirm the final team, repository and whether shaff622 is your hill account.
Please send the final exact graph/weights, density calculation, proof/certificate, paper and submission reference before the cutoff.
Which version should we judge, and is anything still unfinished or blocked?
